items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: Sig had fellas like ... Shorty Williamson, Georgie Petroni, Earl Andrews. ... I was with the band, too.

ctx.x: rehearsal in the old man's saloon. Well, my memory of those kids of the Brunus's, the two, the two that I knew just by sight, was that one of them played an alto and the other one played a trumpet.

Well, Georgie played alto and he played baritone. He did? Yes, he was a little kid. He used to march in the bands, playing baritone. Incidentally, I used to play drum. You did, huh? Yeah, that's something you didn't know. Oh, I sure did.
Well, wasn't there one of those Brunus's that was so small they called him Stick Pin?
